ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (1) Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
tr: Tabārakal-ladhī biyadihil-mulk, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
en: (2) [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
tr: Al-ladhī khalaqal-mawta wal-ḥayāta liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalā, wahuwal-ʿazīzul-ghafūr

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
en: (3) [And] who created seven heavens in layers.[1712] You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
enNotes: [1712]- i.e., one covering or fitting over the other.
tr: Al-ladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqā, mā tarā fī khalqir-raḥmāni min tafāwut, farjiʿil-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr

ar: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
en: (4) Then return [your] vision twice again.[1713] [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
tr: Thummarjiʿil-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-baṣaru khāsiʾaw wahuwa ḥasīr

ar: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (5) And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils[1714] and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
enNotes: [1714]- Thereby driving them from the heavens and preventing them from eavesdropping. See 72:8-9.
tr: Walaqad zayyannas-samāʾad-dunyā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūmal lish-shayāṭīni waʾaʿtadnā lahum ʿadhābas-saʿīr

ar: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (6) And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
tr: Walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannam, wabiʾsal-maṣīr

ar: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
en: (7) When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
tr: Idhā ulqū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqaw wahiya tafūr

ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
en: (8) It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
tr: Takādu tamayyazu minal-ghayẓ, kullamā ulqiya fīhā fawjun saʾalahum khazanatuhā alam yaʾtikum nadhīr

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
en: (9) They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
tr: Qālū balā qad jāʾanā nadhīrun fakadhdhabnā waqulnā mā nazzalallāhu min shayʾ, in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (10) And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
tr: Waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābis-saʿīr

ar: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (11) And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation[1715] for the companions of the Blaze.
enNotes: [1715]- From all good and from Allāh's mercy.
tr: Faʿtarafū bidhambihim, fasuḥqal liʾaṣḥābis-saʿīr

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
en: (12) Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
tr: Innal-ladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratuw waʾajrun kabīr

ar: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (13) And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Waʾasirrū qawlakum awijharū bih, innahū ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: (14) Does He who created not know,[1716] while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
enNotes: [1716]- Another accepted meaning is "Does He not know those whom He created...?"
tr: Alā yaʿlamu man khalaq, wahuwal-laṭīful-khabīr

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
en: (15) It is He who made the earth tame[1717] for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
tr: Huwal-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-arḍa dhalūlan famshū fī manākibihā wakulū mir rizqih, waʾilayhin-nushūr

ar: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
en: (16) Do you feel secure that He who is above[1718] would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?[1719]
enNotes:
[1718]- Literally, "in ascendancy" or "over the heaven."
[1719]- In a circular motion, as in an earthquake.
tr: Aʾamintum man fis-samāʾi ay yakhsifa bikumul-arḍa faʾidhā hiya tamūr

ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
en: (17) Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
tr: Am amintum man fis-samāʾi ay yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣibā, fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
en: (18) And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
tr: Walaqad kadhdhabal-ladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
en: (19) Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
tr: Awalam yaraw ilaṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātiw wayaqbiḍn, mā yumsikuhunna illar-raḥmān, innahū bikulli shayʾim baṣīr

ar: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
en: (20) Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
tr: Amman hādhal-ladhī huwa jundul lakum yanṣurukum min dūnir-raḥmān, inil-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūr

ar: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
en: (21) Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
tr: Amman hādhal-ladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah, bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwiw wanufūr

ar: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (22) Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
tr: Afamay yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihī ahdā ammay yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (23) Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
tr: Qul huwal-ladhī anshaʾakum wajaʿala lakumus-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afʾidah, qalīlam mā tashkurūn

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: (24) Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
tr: Qul huwal-ladhī dharaʾakum fil-arḍi waʾilayhi tuḥsharūn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (25) And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (26) Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
tr: Qul innamal-ʿilmu ʿindallāh, waʾinnamā ana nadhīrum mubīn

ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
en: (27) But when they see it[1720] approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."[1721]
enNotes:
[1720]- The punishment of which they were warned.
[1721]- When they challenged their prophets, saying, "Bring on the punishment, if you are truthful."
tr: Falammā raʾawhu zulfatan sīʾat wujūhul-ladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhal-ladhī kuntum bihī taddaʿūn

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (28) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:[1722] whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
tr: Qul araʾaytum in ahlakaniyallāhu wamam maʿiya aw raḥimanā famay yujīrul-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīm

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (29) Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
tr: Qul huwar-raḥmānu āmannā bihī waʿalayhi tawakkalnā, fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
en: (30) Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
tr: Qul araʾaytum in aṣbaḥa māʾukum ghawran famay yaʾtīkum bimāʾim maʿīn
